newsitem.title: ITALY: India to increase satellite launch capability.
newsitem.headline: India to increase satellite launch capability.

text.p: India expects to build up its capabilities for launching space vehicles as it proceeds with the expansion of its satellite programme, a government official said on Thursday.

"The direction of the Indian space programme in future will be driven by the applications growth," Indian government Department of Space chief K. Narayanan told a conference organised by Italian insurer Generali.

"The programme is directed towards self-reliant use of space technology for socio-economic development, mainly satellite communications, satellite remote sensing to survey resources and the environment, and the construction of satellites and launch vehicles to achieve that aim," he said.
Narayanan said the Indian national Satellite System (INSAT) was being expanded to allow cyclone warning, transmission of television channels and education facilities in universities and villages.
"Planning is now underway for the third generation of INSAT satellites," he said.
